item.title: A14 Drivers to Endure Overnight Closure for Three Months
item.description: Drivers are being warned that a four-and-a-half mile stretch of the A14 in Northamptonshire will be closed overnight for the next three months for essential work to reduce the risk of landslips. The eastbound carriageway between Junction 2 at Kelmarsh and Junction 3 for the A6 near Rothwell will be shut from 8pm to 6am until May. […]

item.description: New drainage and path works will take place to tackle flooding in the dog-walking area near Harborough Leisure Centre. item.description: A petition carrying more than 12,000 signatures opposing plans to expand Leicester’s boundary has been submitted to the government.
